blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: As vision-language models (VLMs) move toward interpreting medical images directly, their outputs increasingly include not just a label but a stated confidence and a written justification. Yet the field still predominantly evaluates VLMs using just accuracy. We evaluate the coherence between answer, confidence, and explanation across four VLMs on breast density and BI-RADS categorization, using two mammography datasets. We perform controlled perturbations of the question, multiple choice option orders, and the images and assess changes in the three outputs. Our results suggest confidence does not decrease even as the mammography image is changed. Shuffling the options also changes most VLMs' answers. Notably, there are cases where a model's own stated reasoning contradicts its final answer, a distinction accuracy alone cannot capture but one that governs whether an AI-generated answer can be trusted.
blocks.zh: 随着视觉语言模型(VLMs)向直接解释医疗图像的方向发展,其产出越来越多地不仅包括一个标签,而且包括一个声明的信心和书面理由。 然而,这个领域仍然主要使用准确性来评估自愿酰胺。 我们利用两个乳房X线照相数据集,评估四个关于乳房密度的VLM和BI-RADS分类的答案、信心和解释之间的一致性。 我们执行对问题的可控扰动、多重选择选择命令、图像和评估三个产出的变化。 我们的结果表明,即使乳房X光照片被改变,信心也不会下降。 shuffing the options也改变大多数VLMs的答案. 值得注意的是,在有些情况下,一个模型自己陈述的推理与它的最后答案相矛盾,单是区分的准确性是不能捕捉到的,而只能支配AI生成的答案是否可以信任。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
An aging population and rising chronic disease burden have placed increasing imaging demand on the U.S. radiology workforce, lengthening patient wait times and contributing to radiologist burnout ( Jing et al., 2025 ) .
Breast cancer screening offers a case study for when this workforce strain has clinical consequence.
The 2024 U.S. Preventive Services Task Force recommendation statement finds biennial mammography screening from ages 40–74 carries a moderate but real mortality benefit, with modeling estimating a 30% relative reduction in breast-cancer mortality compared to no screening ( Force et al., 2024 ) . Thus any degradation in screening capacity or turnaround may negatively impact patient outcomes.
blocks.zh:
人口老化和慢性病负担不断加重,给美国放射队带来了越来越多的成像需求,延长了病人的等候时间,并促成了放射学家的烧伤(Jing等人,2025年)。
乳腺癌筛查提供了一项案例研究,说明当这种劳动力紧张有临床后果时。
2024年美国预防服务工作队的建议说明认为,从40-74岁开始的两年一次的乳房X线照相检查具有中度但实际的死亡率福利,模型估计乳腺癌死亡率相对减少30%,而不是没有筛查(Force等人,2024年)。 因此,筛查能力的任何下降或转变都可能对病人的结果产生不利影响。

blocks.en:
Most mammography AI today assists a human reader rather than replacing one, typically serving as a second reader in the standard double-reading workflow.
However, replacing both readers is a fundamentally different demand than replacing one. A second reader can assume a first read already exists and need only add a risk score or detection, whereas a system replacing both must produce an assessment with reasoning a clinician can audit. This is a different capability than the AI models evaluated in the second-reader studies ( Elhakim et al., 2024 ; Warren et al., 2026 ) , which were typically trained to output a risk score or bounding box rather than a categorical clinical judgment with attached reasoning. This shift to autonomous roles has started to happen with at least one AI system receiving certification for autonomous mammogram triage, bypassing radiologist review for low-risk cases ( Vara, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
今天大多数乳房X光照相AI帮助一个人类读者而不是替换一个,一般在标准的双读工作流程中作为第二位读者.
然而,取代两个读者是一个根本上不同的要求。 第二个读者可以假设第一个读数已经存在,只需要增加一个风险分数或检测,而一个系统必须用临床医生可以审计的推理来取代这两个系统作出评估。 这与二读研究中评价的AI模型(Elhakim等人,2024年;Warren等人,2026年)不同,这些模型通常经过培训,可以输出风险分数或定界框,而不是带有附加推理的绝对临床判断. 这种向自主角色的转变已经开始发生,至少有一个AI系统获得自主乳房X光切片认证,绕过低风险病例的放射学家审查(Vara,2026年).

blocks.en: Vision-language models (VLMs), or models that take images and text as input to reason across both modalities and typically produce text as output, are a natural candidate for this automation task. When framed as a visual question answering (VQA) problem, a VLM can generate a category assessment (e.g., a density score), a confidence estimate, and a natural-language rationale over the screening mammography images, organically mirroring how a radiologist conducts a full read of a mammogram. VLM usage for chest x-rays has been studied heavily, with several VQA benchmarks and robustness analyses ( Liu and others, 2024 ; Lau et al., 2018 ; Pal et al., 2025 ; Fallahpour et al., 2025 ) , but these works largely score only the generated answer, and high performance on such a benchmark is not necessarily sufficient to establish VLM understanding or generalizability. Limited work assesses whether a chest X-ray VLM’s stated reasoning can be trusted rather than just its answer ( Moll et al., 2025 ) or whether existing explanation methods can identify the image regions that actually drove the model’s prediction ( Xiong et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 远景语言模型(VLMs),或将图像和文字作为整个模式的理性输入,并通常以输出方式产生文字的模型,是这一自动化任务的自然候选. 当被设定为视觉问题回答(VQA)问题时,VLM可以生成分类评估(如密度分数),信心估计,以及放映乳房造影图像的自然语言原理,有机地映射放射学家如何进行乳房造影的全读. 胸部X射线的VLM用法已经进行了大量研究,有多个VQA基准和强性分析(刘等人,2024年;刘等人,2018年;Pal等人,2025年;Fallahpour等人,2025年),但这些工作基本上只得生成的答案,在这样的基准上的高性能并不一定足以建立VLM的理解或概括性. 有限的工作评估了胸部X射线VLM所陈述的推理是否可以信任,而不仅仅是它的答案(Moll等人,2025年),或者现有的解释方法是否能够识别实际驱动模型预测的图像区域(Xiong等人,2026年).

blocks.en:
Each of those evaluations, however, still treats one signal at a time.
Separate strands of general-domain VQA research show that each signal is individually unreliable: answers are sensitive to superficial reformatting ( Pezeshkpour and Hruschka, 2024 ; Zheng et al., 2024 ) , models routinely hallucinate a choice rather than abstain ( Tong et al., 2025 ; Demirci et al., 2026 ) , and confidence and reasoning are each known to be poorly calibrated or unfaithful ( Tian et al., 2023 ; Kadavath et al., 2022 ; Seedat and Van Der Schaar, 2025 ; Turpin et al., 2023 ; Bowman et al., 2022 ) .
What remains unseen is the extent to which the output signals (i.e., confidence-derived answer, confidence, and reasoning) agree with each other ,
and whether all three are grounded in the visual evidence, when elicited jointly from the same response. This evidence is necessary for a radiologist to trust or audit an AI-generated read.
blocks.zh:
但是,这些评价仍然每次处理一个信号。
单独的普通领域VQA研究表明,每个信号都各自不可靠:答案对表面重塑敏感(Pezeshkpour和Hruschka, 2024年;Zheng等人, 2024年),模型通常会产生一种选择而不是弃权的幻觉(Tong等人, 2025年;Demirci等人, 2026年),而信心和推理则已知每个信号的校准不准确或不忠实(Tian等人, 2023年;Kadavath等人, 2022年;Seedat和Van Der Schaar, 2025年;Turpin等人, 2023年;Bowman等人, 2022年)。
所未见的是输出信号(即来自信任的答案、信心和推理)彼此一致的程度。
三者是否都以目视证据为依据, 这种证据对于放射科医生信任或审计AI生成的读物是必要的.

blocks.en:
We study this question in mammography rather than chest
radiography, since its interpretation tasks offer several properties well suited to testing coherence. Its two standard interpretation tasks, (i) breast density with American College of Radiology (ACR) categories A–D, and (ii) BI-RADS assessment with categories 0–6, are ordinal and multi-category. Thus a model’s errors, confidence, and reasoning can be graded rather than simply right or wrong. Both label sets are standardized clinical lexicons defined by the ACR and follow a standard imaging protocol so behavior under perturbation can be cleanly attributed. Breast density is also subject to federal reporting and patient-notification requirements in the U.S., and BI-RADS categories directly inform clinical action, from routine recall to biopsy. Here, a model’s confidence and reasoning shape what a patient is told and what happens next.
blocks.zh:
我们用乳房X线照相来研究这个问题
射线摄影,因为它的判读任务提供了几种非常适合测试一致性的特性. 它的两个标准解释任务,(一) 乳腺密度与美国放射学院(ACR)类别A-D, (二) BI-RADS 评估分为0-6类,属于正数类和多类. 因此,模型的错误、信心和推理可以被分级,而不是简单的对或错。 两套标签都是由ACR定义的标准化临床词汇,并遵循标准成像协议,因此扰动下的行为可以被清洁的归因. 乳房密度在美国也受到联邦报告和病人通知要求,BI-RADS类别直接告知临床行动,从例行召回到活体检查. 在这里,模型的信心和推理决定了病人被告知什么,接下来会发生什么。

blocks.en:
We test this using two subsets, RSNA and EMBED, from MammoVQA ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) , the largest VQA benchmark for mammography. Both provide breast density and BI-RADS labels over a large, real screening population. We evaluate four open VLMs. MedGemma-4B and Lingshu-7B are medically trained, while Qwen2-VL-7B and InternVL3-8B are general-purpose. Rather than scoring a single response, we jointly elicit the answer, a per-option confidence score, and a natural-language rationale from the same output, then perturb every question. We replace, blank, or remove the mammogram to probe visual grounding, and reword the question or reorder the options to
probe elicitation robustness. A grounded model should grow less confident as the image degrades and reason consistently with the final assessment. Instead, across both datasets and all four models, we find the opposite. Reasoning is sometimes correct where the scored answer is wrong, confidence fails to track the evidence and at times moves the wrong way, models conflate appropriate abstention with overconfident guessing, and answers flip with the question’s format rather than its content. None of these are visible from accuracy alone.
blocks.zh:
我们用两个子集RSNA和EMBED来测试,它们来自MammoVQA(Zhu等人,2025年),是乳房X光学最大的VQA基准. 两者都提供乳房密度和BI-RADS标签,覆盖大量真实的筛查人口. 我们评价四个公开的VLM. MedGemma-4B和Lingshu-7B接受医学训练,而Qune2-VL-7B和InternVL3-8B则是通用. 我们不是只给一个答复打分,而是共同得出答案,每个选项的自信分数,以及同一产出的自然语言理由,然后扰乱每个问题。 我们更换、空白或去掉乳房X光图以探测视觉地面,并重写问题或重排选项
探测器的引力很强 随着图像的退化和与最后评估一致的理性,一个有底线的模式应当增强信心。 相反,在两个数据集和所有四个模型中,我们发现恰恰相反。 当得分的答案是错误的,信心没有追踪到证据,有时走错路,模型将适当的弃权与过度自信的猜测混为一谈,回答则与问题的格式而非内容翻转,理性有时是正确的. 仅从准确性上看,这些都不是显而易见的。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Evaluating VLMs beyond accuracy. A large body of work probes VLMs beyond a single accuracy score. Reordering multiple-choice options or rephrasing prompts can flip answers and shift reported confidence ( Pezeshkpour and Hruschka, 2024 ; Zheng et al., 2024 ) . Perturbation-based protocols test visual dependence by corrupting, masking, or substituting images ( Tong et al., 2024 ; Moll et al., 2025 ) . Similarly, blind baselines and negation probes expose failures in medical VQA ( Yan et al., 2024 ) . Adversarial “None of the Above” (NOTA) protocols reveal that models often hallucinate answers when no valid option exists, in both general multimodal domains ( Tong et al., 2025 ) and medical diagnostics ( Demirci et al., 2026 ) . These methods primarily assess answer correctness or visual dependence, whereas we examine how answers, confidence, and reasoning jointly respond to visual perturbations.
blocks.zh: 评估超出准确度的VLM. 大量的工作探测器的VLM超过了单一的精度分数. 重排多选择选项或重写提示可以翻转答案并转移报告的信心(Pezeshkpour and Hruschka, 2024;Zheng等人, 2024). 基于扰动的协议通过腐蚀,蒙面,或替代图像来测试视觉依赖性(Tong等人,2024年;Moll等人,2025年). 同样,盲目基线和否定探测器暴露了医学VQA中的故障(Yan等人,2024年)。 横向 “上述任何一种”(NOTA)协议都表明,在一般多式联运领域(Tong等人,2025年)和医疗诊断领域(Demirci等人,2026年)都不存在有效选择的情况下,模型往往会产生幻觉。 这些方法主要评估答案正确性或视觉依赖性,而我们则研究答案,信心和推理如何共同应对视觉扰动.

blocks.en: Output coherence and confidence calibration. Faithfulness methods assess whether explanations reflect the model’s internal decision process. Siegel et al. ( Siegel et al., 2024 ) use counterfactual edits to measure changes in predicted probabilities and whether explanations acknowledge those edits. Parcalabescu and Frank ( Parcalabescu and Frank, 2024 ) examine explanation faithfulness and self-consistency, while interventional tests probe chain-of-thought faithfulness by corrupting reasoning traces ( Lanham et al., ) . These methods address internal faithfulness, whereas we assess whether a rationale agrees with its selected answer and the imaging evidence. Confidence calibration is likewise studied through aggregate calibration error ( Du et al., 2026 ) and methods that elicit fidelity across sampled responses ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) . In contrast, we examine whether confidence responds to visual evidence and agrees with the answer and rationale within a single response. Aggregate calibration and cross-sample consistency do not establish such within-response coherence.
blocks.zh: 产出一致性和信心校准。 忠诚的方法评估解释是否反映了模型的内部决策程序. Siegel等人著. (Siegel等人,2024年)使用反事实编辑来衡量预测概率的变化以及解释是否承认这些编辑. Parcalabescu和Frank(Parcalabescu和Frank,2024年)研究解释的忠诚和自我一致性,而干预测试则通过腐蚀推理痕迹来探寻思维的忠诚链(Lanham等人,). 这些方法涉及内部的忠诚,而我们评估一个理由是否与其选定的答案和成像证据一致。 同样,通过汇总校准误差(Du等人,2026年)和在抽样答复中产生忠贞性的方法(Zhang等人,2024年)来研究信心校准。 与此相反,我们审查信心是否对视觉证据作出反应,并同意在单一答复中的答复和理由。 综合校准和交叉抽样一致性不能建立这种反应内部的一致性。

blocks.en: Medical VLM evaluation. VLMs for chest radiography are evaluated predominantly using report-derived accuracy metrics, including exact- or close-match accuracy on VQA pairs ( Liu and others, 2024 ; Lau et al., 2018 ) and overlap between generated and reference reports ( Liu and others, 2024 ) . Mammography-specific VLMs follow a similar pattern. MammoVLM ( Cao et al., 2025 ) reports performance approaching junior-radiologist-level performance on a private dataset, based on radiologist ratings of correctness, rationality, helpfulness, professionalism, and completeness. A separate reinforcement learning-based VLM ( Li et al., 2026 ) is trained on EMBED data using a domain-specific reward but evaluates performance primarily through answer correctness. Neither model’s weights are publicly released.
blocks.zh: 医学VLM评价. 用于胸腺射线的VLM主要使用报告衍生的精度测量值来评价,包括VQA对(刘等人,2024年;刘等人,2018年)的精确或近距离匹配精度,以及生成和参考报告(刘等人,2024年)的重叠. 特定乳房造影术 VLMs遵循类似的模式. 哺乳动物 (Cao等人,2025年)根据放射学家对正确性、合理性、帮助性、专业性和完整性的评级,在一个私人数据集上报告接近初级放射学家水平的绩效。 一个单独的基于强化学习的VLM(Li et al., 2026)在EMBED数据上接受了使用特定域奖励的训练,但主要通过回答正确性来评价性能. 两个模型的重量都不公开发布。

blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Figure 1: Our proposed evaluation methodology with six conditions: the original image and five perturbations.
blocks.zh: 图1:我们提出的评价方法有六个条件:原始图像和五个扰动。

blocks.en: 3.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 概览

blocks.en: General VLM research probes accuracy, reasoning, and confidence individually with limited work on how these signals interrelate. There is limited work detecting when a model is confidently wrong, right in its explanation yet wrong in its answer, or unchanged by the removal of the image. We address this gap directly. For each visual question, a VLM produces three signals a clinician might rely on: the answer it selects, the confidence it reports, and the reasoning it gives. We jointly elicit all three from a single response and test whether they agree with each other and with the visual evidence, using mammography as a testbed, under five controlled perturbations, shown in Figure 1 , known to affect model responses. We also provide the code to reproduce our results.
blocks.zh: 一般VLM研究探究准确性,推理性,以及个人的信心,对这些信号如何相互连接的工作有限. 当一个模型有自信地错误,在解释中正确,但在回答中错误,或者通过删除图像而保持不变时,工作发现有限. 我们直接解决这一差距。 对于每个视觉问题,一个VLM产生一个临床医生可能依赖的三个信号:它选择的答案,它报告的信任,以及它给出的推理. 我们共同从一个单一的响应中引出所有三个,测试它们是否彼此同意,是否与视觉证据一致,利用乳房X光照相作为试验床,低于图1所示的5个可控扰动,已知影响模型响应. 我们还提供了复制结果的代码。

blocks.en: 3.2 Dataset and Tasks
blocks.zh: 3.2 数据集和任务

blocks.en: We use the MammoVQA benchmark ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) , focusing on its two largest cohorts, the RSNA screening mammography dataset ( Radiological Society of North America, 2023 ) and EMBED ( Jeong et al., 2023 ) . We study two interpretation tasks: breast density (ACR categories A–D) and BI-RADS assessment (categories 0–6), both of which in theory require reading the image rather than exploiting coarse spatial cues. The RSNA screening cohort contains N = 5,106 N{=}5{,}106 BI-RADS assessment and N = 5,821 N{=}5{,}821 breast density / ACR items while EMBED contains N = 14,303 N{=}14{,}303 BI-RADS assessment items. Each item is a single mammographic image (RSNA) or multiple exam images (EMBED) paired with a templated question, a fixed option set, and a benchmark label y y (detailed statistics in Appendix 7 ).
blocks.zh: 我们使用MammoVQA基准(Zhu等人,2025年),重点是其两个最大的组群,即RSNA筛查乳房X线照相数据集(北美放射学会,2023年)和EMBED(Jeong等人,2023年)。 我们研究两个解释任务:乳房密度(ACR类别A-D)和BI-RADS评估(类别0-6),在理论上这两个任务都要求阅读图像而不是利用粗细的空间提示。 RSNA筛选组包含N=5,106 N{=}5{,}106 BI-RADS评估与N=5,821 N{=}5{,}821 乳房密度/ACR项目,而EMBED包含N=14,303 N{=}14{,}303 BI-RADS评估项目. 每个项目都是一个单一的乳腺造影图像(RSNA)或多个测试图像(EMBED)与一个模板问题组合,一个固定选项集,以及一个基准标签yy(附录7中的详细统计).

blocks.en: 3.3 Signal elicitation
blocks.zh: 3.3 信号诱导

blocks.en:
We elicit the answer, confidence, and reasoning jointly using a structured multiple-choice prompt with per-option confidence scores following the Matchmaker formulation ( Seedat and Van Der Schaar, 2025 ) . ( Seedat and Van Der Schaar, 2025 ) .
The original MammoVQA benchmark poses each question as a closed multiple-choice question (MCQ) with no option for rejecting the offered choices. Since we will perturb the original image, none of the original options are correct, so the existing options would force the model into an arbitrary wrong answer and provide no mechanism for distinguishing a grounded refusal from a guess. We therefore augment each question with an explicit NOTA (“ None of the above ”) option, representing the claim
that no listed answer is correct.
blocks.zh:
我们用一个结构化的多选择提示, (Seedat和Van Der Schaar,2025年).
最初的MammoVQA基准将每个问题作为一个封闭的多选择问题(MCQ)提出,没有选择拒绝所给出的选择. 因为我们会扰动原始图像,所以原始选项没有一个是正确的,所以现有选项会迫使模型变成任意错误的答案,也没有提供机制来区分有根据的拒绝和猜测. 因此,我们用一个明确的NOTA( " 上述任何一种 " )选项来补充每个问题,代表索赔要求。
没有列出的答案是正确的。

blocks.en: 3.4 Perturbation conditions
blocks.zh: 3.4 扰动条件

blocks.en:
Each question is evaluated under 6 conditions: an original baseline using the unmodified question and mammogram, and 5 conditions
that perturb the visual evidence or the elicitation while holding the question otherwise fixed. The K K options plus NOTA are presented under every condition. The 3 visual perturbations probe grounding: a VLM that reads the image should change its behavior when the image is made uninformative or removed. Under the unrelated condition, the mammogram is replaced with an unrelated natural photograph. In the blank scenario, it is replaced with a blank, grayscale image. For the no-image perturbation, the image is omitted entirely and the model answers from the question text alone, probing the model’s language prior in the absence of any visual input.
The two elicitation perturbations hold the mammogram fixed and instead alter how the question and answer are posed, isolating a format effect independent
of the evidence. Under the perturbed-question condition, any domain-specific terminology is neutralized (e.g., “mammogram” is replaced with
“image”) to probe sensitivity to wording. In perturbed-options scenario, the answer options are shuffled and augmented with paraphrase filler distractors (e.g., “Not Assessable,” “Not Applicable”) alongside NOTA, probing sensitivity to option order and format.

blocks.en: Reasoning Accuracy. We combine a label matcher with a definition-based semantic matcher. (i) The label matcher identifies explicit category mentions by locating task cues (“BI-RADS” for assessment; “level”, “category”, “ACR”, or “density” for density) and extracting the nearby category token (digit 0–6 for BI-RADS; letter A–D for density), using the last match when several occur. (ii) The semantic matcher maps descriptions of findings to categories using official definitions. For example,  “no abnormality / negative” → \rightarrow BI-RADS 1 and “almost entirely fatty / scattered fibroglandular / heterogeneously dense / extremely dense” → \rightarrow A/B/C/D, while also identifying “none of the above” conclusions.

blocks.en: 3.6 Models

blocks.en: We evaluate four open VLMs spanning medical and general-purpose training: MedGemma-4B and Lingshu-7B (medical), and Qwen2-VL-7B and InternVL3-8B (general). These models were selected for three reasons: (1) open weights enable reproducibility without costly API access, excluding closed-source models (e.g., GPT-4V and Gemini Ultra) and mammography-specific systems ( Cao et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026 ) whose weights are unavailable; (2) the selection enables comparison of medical versus general-purpose training; and (3) the 4–8B parameter range, using unquantized models, limits differences attributable to model scale and quantization. All models receive an identical instruction; only the model-specific chat template and image-token convention differ (checkpoint and inference settings in Appendix 6 ). Decoding is greedy for reproducibility.

blocks.en:
Coherent does not mean valid. Within the agreement buckets, the findings a model describes often fail to warrant the category it assigns. Figure 4 shows this on a single screening exam (ground truth BI-RADS 0). InternVL assigns BI-RADS 0 and is therefore scored correct , yet its rationale describes the breast as normal with no abnormalities, a BI-RADS 1
reading, so the category it reports contradicts the finding it describes. MedGemma reads the exam the
same way but, reasoning validly from “normal,” assigns BI-RADS 1 and is scored wrong . Accuracy
thus credits the model whose reasoning is self-contradictory and penalises the one whose reasoning is
sound: a correct label is no evidence that the model read the image correctly, and only inspecting the
rationale exposes the disconnect. This is not an isolated case. Across the agreement buckets, the findings a model describes routinely fail to justify the category it assigns. Additional results are in Appendix 8.1 .

blocks.en: Figure 6 reports what happens when the answer options are shuffled, measured as the share of items whose stated answer changes, split by whether the change helps, hurts, or leaves accuracy unchanged. An answer read from the mammogram would be invariant to the order in which the choices are listed; instead we see flip rates of 40 40 – 99 % 99\% ( 77 % 77\% for MedGemma and 57 % 57\% for InternVL on BI-RADS, 55 55 – 78 % 78\% on density). That a single reordering overturns most answers indicates that the choice is anchored to the surface arrangement of the options rather than to evidence in the image. The direction of the flips makes the same point: they are overwhelmingly neutral (wrong → \rightarrow wrong), so reordering reshuffles an already-ungrounded guess rather than correcting it, and where accuracy does move it predominantly hurts (net − 24.8 -24.8 for MedGemma to + 13.4 +13.4 for InternVL on BI-RADS). Qwen is the most volatile, flipping on 99 % 99\% of BI-RADS and 75 % 75\% of density items almost entirely by retreating to a newly-introduced NOTA/filler option ( 56 % 56\% and 48 % 48\% of all items): its answer tracks whichever safe option is present, not the image. The asymmetries are significant under McNemar’s test (Appendix 8.4 ). Rewording the question, by contrast, leaves most answers intact (Appendix 8.3 ), so the fragility is specific to option structure, not phrasing.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en:
Our results show that a model’s answer, confidence, and explanation are largely decoupled from the
imaging evidence, and that coherence among these signals does not imply sound reasoning. This is a different problem from the one most medical VLM evaluation is built to catch. Accuracy-based benchmarks assume a wrong answer reflects a gap in knowledge or perception, but the gap here can instead sit within the reasoning itself, or between the stated answer and the explanation. We cannot distinguish whether the explanation reflects the model’s actual decision process or is a post-hoc rationalization generated somewhat independently of it. Prior work on chain-of-thought faithfulness suggests the latter is common ( Turpin et al., 2023 ; Bowman et al., 2022 ) , and recent work on visual grounding of VLM rationales finds explanations are often produced after only a superficial inspection of the image, with individual steps unsupported by the evidence they cite ( Yi and Shang, 2025 ) . Either way, the explanation is a signal a clinician would plausibly act on, so its disagreement with the stated answer, or its invalidity, is a practical problem for trust and auditability regardless of which signal is closer to the model’s true internal state. This same ambiguity extends to abstention: a high refusal rate under evidence removal can reflect genuine grounding or a fixed refusal policy, and only comparing it against the real-image rate tells the two apart.
blocks.zh:
我们的结果表明,一个模型的答案、信心和解释在很大程度上与
成像证据,这些信号的一致性并不意味着合理的推理。 这是一个不同于最医学的 VLM 评估 建立捕获。 基于准确性的基准假设一个错误的答案反映了知识或感知上的空白,但这里的差距却可以坐落在推理本身,或者在陈述的答案和解释之间. 我们无法区分解释是否反映了模型的实际决定过程,或者是否是在某种程度上独立于模型之后产生的合理化。 先前关于思维链忠诚的研究表明,后者是常见的(Turpin等人,2023年;Bowman等人,2022年),最近关于视觉定位VLM原理的著作发现,在对图像进行表面检查后,往往会产生解释,个别步骤得不到他们引用的证据的支持(Yi和Shang,2025年)。 无论哪种方式,解释都是一种临床医生可以合理操作的信号,因此,它与所陈述的答案的分歧,或者其无效性,对于信任和可审计性来说是一个实际问题,不管哪个信号更接近模型的真正内部状态。 同样的模糊性延伸到弃权:证据清除下的高拒绝率可以反映真正的基于或固定的拒绝政策,而将它与真实图像率进行比较只能使两者相区别。

blocks.en: 5.1 Limitations and Future Work.
blocks.zh: 5.1 限制和未来工作。

blocks.en: Our evaluation relies solely on MammoVQA’s templated multiple-choice formulation, so some option-order and wording sensitivity may reflect the task framing. Extending the protocol to free-response or report-generation formats would test its generality. We also evaluate open, general-purpose and medically-adapted VLMs because mammography-specialized systems have not released their weights; whether domain-specific fine-tuning changes the coherence failures remains an open question.
blocks.zh: 我们的评价完全依靠MammoVQA的多选择模板配方,因此一些选择顺序和措辞敏感性可能反映任务框架。 将协议扩大到自由答复或报告生成格式将检验其普遍性。 我们还评价公开的、通用的和医学上适应的VLM,因为乳房X光照相专门系统尚未释放其权重;特定域的微调是否改变一致性的失败仍然是一个未决问题。

blocks.en: A separate direction concerns the confidence-evidence inversion we observe. This may relate to mirage reasoning, where multimodal models produce confident clinical descriptions without image input ( Asadi et al., 2026 ) . Testing explicit versus implicit image-removal prompts could help distinguish these phenomena.
blocks.zh: 另一个方向涉及我们所观察到的信任-证据倒置。 这可能与幻影推理有关,即多式联运模型在没有图像输入的情况下产生自信的临床描述(Asadi等人,2026年)。 测试明确和隐含的图像清除提示可有助于区分这些现象。

blocks.en: Our perturbations omit clinically relevant changes such as swapped laterality or view, and same-patient prior images. Post-hoc verification methods could test whether reasoning-correct, answer-wrong items reflect visual grounding ( Yi and Shang, 2025 ) . Our reasoning matcher was validated on a modest sample, and parse rates vary across models. Future work could compare verbalized with logit-based confidence, since independent option scores do not necessarily form a distribution the way normalized probabilities do.
blocks.zh: 我们的扰动省略了临床上相关的变化,例如互换后期或视图,以及同病人以前的图像。 hoc后核查方法可以测试推理正确,回答错误的物品是否反映视觉地面(Yi和Shang,2025年). 我们的推理匹配者 被验证 在适度的样本, 和剖析率 不同模型。 今后的工作可以将口头表述与基于逻辑的信任相比较,因为独立选项的分数不一定像正常概率那样形成分布。

blocks.en: 9 Additional EMBED Results
blocks.zh: 9 增加额 结果

blocks.en:
We repeat the four main-text analyses on EMBED BI-RADS (up to N = 14,303 N{=}14{,}303 items;
majority-class prior 62.1 % 62.1\% , “BI-RADS 1”). EMBED is exam-level : each instance is a full mammography exam of 1–15 views rather than a single image, and the model sees all views at once. The visual perturbations preserve
this structure—each exam’s views are replaced by the same number of blank images, or by
the same number of distinct unrelated photos—so an exam of n n real views becomes n n blank (or n n unrelated) images. The trends broadly follow RSNA and are often more extreme, driven by EMBED’s stronger class imbalance and exam-level setting.
